description: A single vertical flow schematic (no axes, no scale bar, no numeric data) depicting the phase-transformation sequence by which κ-carbide forms from ferrite in a lean-Mn Fe-Mn-Al-C lightweight steel. Reading top to bottom: a bold α label sits at the head, with a downward arrow leading to an ellipse labelled γ, annotated "γ nucleation and growth". A second arrow leads to a larger γ ellipse bearing a small κ marker at its rim, annotated "Formation of ring of κ-carbide at α/γ interface". A third arrow leads to a γ ellipse now encircled by a necklace of small oval grains labelled κ and α, annotated "Fragmentation and globulization of the ring of κ-carbide". From this stage two arrows branch downwards, labelled "One or both". The left branch shows an ellipse with a hatched, fibre-like interior still ringed by κ and α grains, captioned "Total or partial transformation of γ". The right branch shows an ellipse with a finely stippled interior, also ringed by κ and α grains, captioned "Modulated structure (γ → γ + κ-carbide)". The schematic argues that α first yields γ, κ-carbide nucleates at the α/γ interface, fragments into globules, after which γ either transforms totally/partially or persists as a modulated γ + κ-carbide structure.

observations.observation: The schematic begins at the top with a bold α label (ferrite) pointing downward to a γ (austenite) stage, so α → γ is the first step of the sequence.
The second stage is annotated "γ nucleation and growth".
The third stage annotates "Formation of ring of κ-carbide at α/γ interface", and shows a small κ marker on the rim of the γ ellipse.
The fourth stage annotates "Fragmentation and globulization of the ring of κ-carbide", drawn as a necklace of small oval grains labelled both κ and α surrounding the γ ellipse.
After the fragmentation stage the schematic splits into two alternative branches joined by arrows labelled "One or both".
The left branch caption reads "Total or partial transformation of γ" and is drawn with a hatched, fibre-like interior inside the γ ellipse.
The right branch caption reads "Modulated structure (γ → γ + κ-carbide)" and is drawn with a finely stippled interior inside the γ ellipse.
The figure carries no axes, units, scale bar or numeric values — it is a purely qualitative mechanism/sequence schematic.

The caption states the figure is a schematic presentation of the phase-transformation sequences involved in formation of κ-carbide from ferrite (printed as "j-carbide") in a lean-Mn containing Fe-Mn-Al-C alloy.
The diagram labels the phase forming the interface ring as κ-carbide (κ) alongside α within the same globular arrangement.

subfigures.description: Head of the flow: a bold α label with a downward arrow leading to an ellipse labelled γ, annotated "γ nucleation and growth" — the first step, transformation of ferrite to austenite.
A second downward arrow leads to a γ ellipse carrying a small κ marker at its rim, annotated "Formation of ring of κ-carbide at α/γ interface".
A third arrow leads to a γ ellipse encircled by a necklace of small oval grains labelled κ and α, annotated "Fragmentation and globulization of the ring of κ-carbide".
Branch of the split ("One or both"): a γ ellipse with a hatched, fibre-like interior still ringed by κ and α grains, labelled "Total or partial transformation of γ".
Second branch of the split: an ellipse with a finely stippled interior ringed by κ and α grains, labelled "Modulated structure (γ → γ + κ-carbide)".
